description: Integration gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 test of problems/latlon3d_advection_3d.esm (model Advection3d, test mms_steady_3d_combined) at the problem's fixed resolution (NLON=36, NLAT=19, NLEV=10) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises all THREE latlon3d directional advection rules firing together on one [lon,lat,lev] field — upwind1_D_lon_periodic + central_D_lat_zero_grad_bc + central_D_lev_zero_grad_bc — assembling into a single RHS with a forced-steady manufactured solution, to prove the rank-3 3-D advection operator composes and integrates without match conflict. The per-direction order claims are proven separately by the three latlon3d convergence cases; this manifest only routes the runners (assertions + tolerances live in the problem).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
